subject: model that compiles in CmdStan but not RStan

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: model that compiles in CmdStan but not RStan
parts:
I was about to try and fix

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1810

when I realized that it works just fine in CmdStan (though it does
find a signed vs. unsigned comparison issue in g++ 4.7).

I don't want to just move this issue over to RStan without
checking whether it's caused by something in Stan or Stan Math.

I verified the issue is *not* because of Eigen 3.2.8; it still
compiles in CmdStan with Eigen 3.2.8 plugged in. And CmdStan works
fine with both g++4.7 and clang++ (whatever the recent flavor is
in Xcode).

The compile error arises from an instantiation of the generated
model class in rstan/stan_fit.hpp and it looks like
SEXPREC* is getting pasted in and interpreted as a numerical
type and Eigen can't figure out how to assign to it.

- Bob
